subject: reasoning
question:
Rishika starts from point A and drives 49 km towards north. She then takes a left turn, drives 51 km, turns left and drives 54 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 64 km. She takes a final left turn, drives 5 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Rishika starts from point A and drives 49 km towards north. She then takes a left turn, drives 51 km, turns left and drives 54 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 64 km. She takes a final left turn, drives 5 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dd0e6e01bdc9364acd6c33a4a142143210f6201f9f9dcc4ff5eae9135ceca24.png] 

Thus, she should drive 13 km to the west in order to reach point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
